about: General category list for regional bundles (decision 213, plan 138): input of `qgen taxonomy --bundle <id>`, which adds the region's own categories and proposes subcategories; a category may be left out for a region with too little to ask. Authoring only, never read by app/. {región} = the region's name; names repeat across bundles (decision 110 (d)). Everywhere excluded (D-49): what players anywhere in the Spanish-speaking world answer without a connection to the region, and world topics: they stay in base.

categories.name: Geografía de {región}
categories.scope: Provinces/departments, cities and towns, rivers, mountains, coasts, islands, landmarks and monuments, roads and distances.
categories.excludes: Country-level facts known worldwide (base Capitales del mundo, Países del mundo, Monumentos famosos).

categories.name: Naturaleza de {región}
categories.scope: Native animals and plants, national parks and reserves, ecosystems, climate and seasons, natural phenomena.
categories.excludes: Animals and plants known worldwide without a regional angle (base Animales, Plantas, Amazonas).

categories.name: Historia de {región}
categories.scope: Indigenous peoples before the conquest, colony, independence, wars and founding figures, 19th–20th century, presidents and turning points.
categories.excludes: World history (base Historia); current party politics.

categories.name: Personajes de {región}
categories.scope: Well-known people not covered by music, sport, arts or TV: scientists, inventors, business founders, heroes of daily life, popular characters.
categories.excludes: Names known worldwide (base); musicians, athletes, writers, actors go to their categories.

categories.name: Comida y bebida de {región}
categories.scope: Typical dishes, sweets and desserts, drinks, fruits and ingredients, regional variants, markets and street food.
categories.excludes: International food (base Comida y bebida, Comida latinoamericana: arepa as a name, coffee in general).

categories.name: Fiestas y tradiciones de {región}
categories.scope: Festivals, carnivals, fairs, holidays, family customs, crafts, traditional dress and games.
categories.excludes: World festivals and customs (base Fiestas y tradiciones, Trajes típicos del mundo).

categories.name: Mitos y leyendas de {región}
categories.scope: Legendary creatures, ghost stories, popular beliefs and superstitions, indigenous myths.
categories.excludes: World mythologies and generic superstitions (base Mitos y leyendas, Leyendas y supersticiones).

categories.name: Música y baile de {región}
categories.scope: Rhythms and dances, instruments, singers and bands, famous songs, music festivals.
categories.excludes: World music and global stars by name only (base Música).

categories.name: Arte y literatura de {región}
categories.scope: Writers and books, poets, painters and sculptors, architecture, museums, comics.
categories.excludes: World literature and art (base Arte y literatura; García Márquez basics).

categories.name: Cine y televisión de {región}
categories.scope: Telenovelas, series, films, presenters, actors, radio, cartoons, internet celebrities.
categories.excludes: International film and TV (base Cine, series y superhéroes).

categories.name: Deporte de {región}
categories.scope: National teams, clubs, athletes, Olympic medals, the region's favourite sports, traditional games and sports.
categories.excludes: World football and sport (base Fútbol, Deportes).

categories.name: Así se habla en {región}
categories.scope: Words and slang, sayings and expressions, accents, loanwords from indigenous languages, the region's own languages.
categories.excludes: Spanish in general (base Idiomas y palabras, Refranes y dichos).

categories.name: Vida diaria en {región}
categories.scope: Money and banknotes, brands and products, shops, transport, school, home, everyday objects and habits, public services.
categories.excludes: World brands and money (base Marcas y logotipos, Monedas y dinero).

categories.name: Símbolos de {región}
categories.scope: Flag, anthem, coat of arms, national symbols (bird, tree, flower), emblems of the provinces/cities.
categories.excludes: The flag as recognised worldwide (base Banderas del mundo).
